_readme: 1) In Telegram talk to @BotFather -> /newbot -> it gives you a token
2) Paste that token between the quotes on the token line below
3) Open your bot in Telegram and press START (or add it to a group and post a message)
Or just double-click SETUP_Telegram.bat which walks you through all of it.
This file is gitignored - the token never reaches GitHub.
_snapshot_note: snapshot_new_message_minutes: how often a genuinely NEW photo is posted. Use 4 (not 5) for one per 5-minute cycle - an exact 5 skips a round whenever a cycle lands a few seconds early. 0 = only edit the existing photo.
